translation: By the daybreak
And ten nights
And the even and the odd
And the night as it recedes

arabic: هَلۡ فِي ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٞ لِّذِي حِجۡرٍ
translation: Is there in this an oath for a rational person

arabic: أَلَمۡ تَرَ كَيۡفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
translation: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with Aad
Erum of the pillars

arabic: ٱلَّتِي لَمۡ يُخۡلَقۡ مِثۡلُهَا فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
translation: The like of which was never created in the land
And Thamood—those who carved the rocks in the valley
And Pharaoh of the Stakes
Those who committed excesses in the lands
And spread much corruption therein
So your Lord poured down upon them a scourge of punishment
Your Lord is on the lookout

arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكۡرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَكۡرَمَنِ
translation: As for man, whenever his Lord tests him, and honors him, and prospers him, he says, “My Lord has honored me.”

arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
translation: But whenever He tests him, and restricts his livelihood for him, he says, “My Lord has insulted me.”
Not at all. But you do not honor the orphan
And you do not urge the feeding of the poor
And you devour inheritance with all greed
And you love wealth with immense love

arabic: كـَلَّآۖ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ دَكّٗا دَكّٗا
translation: No—when the earth is leveled, pounded, and crushed
And your Lord comes, with the angels, row after row

arabic: وَجِاْيٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِجَهَنَّمَۚ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ
translation: And on that Day, Hell is brought forward. On that Day, man will remember, but how will remembrance avail him
He will say, “If only I had forwarded for my life.”
On that Day, none will punish as He punishes
And none will shackle as He shackles
But as for you, O tranquil soul
Return to your Lord, pleased and accepted
Enter among My servants
Enter My Paradise
